title: Jacobi's formula: det on L(ℝⁿ) is C¹ with D det(T)[H] = det T · trace(T⁻¹H) at units
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, the determinant det : L(ℝⁿ) → ℝ, T ↦ T.det (ContinuousLinearMap.det), is C¹, and for every unit T of the ring L(ℝⁿ) (multiplication = composition) and every H ∈ L(ℝⁿ), D det(T)[H] = det T · trace(T⁻¹ ∘ H), where T⁻¹ := Ring.inverse T and trace is the trace of endomorphisms of ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun T : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n ↦ T.det) ∧ ∀ T H : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n, IsUnit T → fderiv ℝ (fun T : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n ↦ T.det) T H = T.det * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse T ∘L H).toLinearMap
